data.title: Sobha Seahaven
data.about:
Seahaven lets you wake up to the tranquil sounds of the waves, escape the rush and bustle of the city, and reconnect with the blue oceans. Sobha offers incredible views of the renowned Palm Jumeirah, the fascinating Dubai Harbour and Marina skyline, and the Burj Al Arab.

At Sobha Seahaven, apartments range from contemporary one to three bedrooms in a tower inspired by the wind, the ocean, and luxury boats. Embark on an adventure at Sobha Seahaven and discover your piece of heaven.

location_tile.title: Strategic Location – Mouth of Dubai Harbour
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
In a peaceful nook of the Marina and Harbour, Seahaven is a unique waterfront community nestled among the city’s most recognizable landmarks. Located halfway between two international airports, Sobha Seahaven is an attractive sea-facing home.

02 mins from Mohd Bin Zayed Road
10 mins from Downtown Dubai
15 mins from Jumeirah beach
15 Mins Dubai Airport
